kits.lore_fire: Fire crews ran toward trouble when everyone else ran away. Zombita kept their gear for people like you.
kits.lore_police: The station's lockers, cleaned out and sorted by Zombita. Protect people with it, like they did.
kits.lore_sheriff: A county deputy's kit, star polished. Zombita says the county is yours to look after now.
kits.lore_army: Surplus from the base at the edge of the map. Zombita signed for it so you would not have to.
kits.lore_medic: From the hospital's last clean ward. Zombita wants every one of you patched up and breathing.
kits.lore_paramedic: The ambulance never made its last run. Its bags did, and Zombita packed them fresh.
kits.lore_mechanic: Grease, spare parts and a good wrench. Zombita knows a running car saves lives.
kits.lore_farmer: Somebody has to grow the food. Zombita hopes it is you, and she will buy the first tomato.
kits.lore_chef: A real kitchen's tools and whites. Zombita says a hot meal is the best medicine she knows.
kits.lore_hunter: Camo, a sharp knife and a quiet step. Zombita asks you to hunt the dead, and feed the living.
kits.lore_archer: Quiet shots, arrows you can pick back up. Zombita likes a hunter who wastes nothing.
kits.lore_fisher: Hat, hook and a good book on the river. Zombita says patience feeds more people than bullets.
kits.lore_carpenter: Hammer, saw and a box of nails. Zombita says every safe house started with someone like you.
kits.lore_smith: Hot iron and a steady hammer. Zombita keeps the forge warm for anyone willing to learn.
kits.lore_glass: Sand, fire and patience. Zombita loves a window that keeps the cold out and lets the light in.
kits.lore_tailor: Needle, thread and a good eye. Zombita says a warm coat is a life saved in winter.
kits.lore_electric: Wire, pliers and the know-how. Zombita says the lights coming back on is the best sound in town.
kits.lore_lumber: Flannel and a good axe. Zombita says the forest gives the wood, you give the work.
kits.lore_ranger: The ranger station's spare gear. Zombita hopes you love the woods as much as they did.
kits.lore_trucker: Long roads, full tanks and something to chew on. Zombita says keep on trucking, and wave when you pass.
kits.lore_survivor: For people who live off the land. Zombita packed it light, so you can keep moving.
kits.lore_prepper: They saw it coming and stocked up. Zombita thinks they would want you to have it.
kits.lore_raider: Taken off a raider crew that will not need it anymore. Zombita asks you to use it better than they did.
kits.lore_gunsmith: Presses, primers and parts. Zombita says a well kept gun is a gun that works when you need it.
kits.lore_martial: Wraps, blades and the books to use them. Zombita says a steady hand beats a loud gun.
kits.lore_welder: Rods, sheet steel and a torch. Zombita says a welded wall stops what a nailed one cannot.
kits.lore_builder: Hard hats and hi-vis from the site office. Zombita says walls first, worries later.
kits.lore_rancher: Boots, hat and rope from the old ranch. Zombita says the animals still need someone kind.
kits.lore_biker: Leather from a club that rode its last ride. Zombita says ride safe and look good doing it.
kits.lore_scav: The bag every good scavenger carries. Zombita filled it with what you will reach for first.
kits.lore_hazmat: Suits and masks from the clean-up crew. Zombita says what you cannot see can still hurt you.
kits.lore_athlete: The team's kit bag, still smelling of the locker room. Zombita says play hard and stay safe.
kits.lore_spiffo: Found in the back of a Spiffo's. Zombita laughed for a full minute, then wrapped it for you.
kits.lore_herbalist: Seeds for the plants that heal. Zombita grows comfrey by her kiosk, just in case.
kits.lore_dawnie: Lady Dawnie left these at the kiosk again. Zombita thinks they will look even better on you.
